new.title: Send a transfer
new.chatHint: The group sees the transfer as a card in the chat.

files.label: Files
files.helper: You can pick several files at once. Up to {max} in total.

emails.title: Email addresses
emails.description: For people outside the app. They get a personal link by email. Up to {max} addresses.

consent.hint: Does the file show other people? Only share it if they agree.

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: A few words about the files
message.helper: Optional. Everyone who receives the transfer sees this message.

lifetime.label: Available for (days)
lifetime.helper: After that the files are deleted. Up to {max} days.

password.label: Password
password.helper: Optional. Pass the password on to the people outside the app yourself. Members do not need it.

info.title: How a transfer works
info.what: With a transfer you send large files, for example a training video, to groups, to single members or to people outside the app.
info.limitOpen: All your open transfers together: up to {size}
info.limitExternals: Email addresses per transfer: up to {count}
info.lifetime: A transfer usually lasts {days} days, at most {max} days.
info.whoMembers: Members get a notification and open the transfer in the app.
info.whoGroups: A group sees the transfer as a card in its chat.
info.whoOutside: People outside the app get a personal link by email.
info.deleted: When the time is up, the files are deleted.
info.log: We keep a record of who sends a transfer and who opens or downloads it. We do not store IP addresses.
info.requestText: Then write to the people in charge. They can raise your limits.
info.reasonPlaceholder: What do you need more space for?

card.title: Transfer
card.notShared: Nobody sent this transfer to you. Ask the person who shared it.

limits.title: Transfer limits
limits.transferHelper: How much one person may send at once.
limits.openHelper: How much one person may be sharing at the same time.
limits.ceilingHelper: Not even an exception may allow more than this.
limits.defaultLifetimeHelper: How long a transfer lasts unless the person chooses otherwise.
limits.externalsHelper: How many people outside the app one transfer may reach.
limits.overridesHelper: These people may send more than the others.

rejection.tooLarge: Together, the files are larger than you may send at once.
rejection.openTotalExceeded: You are already sharing a lot of files. End an older transfer or wait until it expires.
rejection.tooManyExternals: That is too many email addresses for one transfer.
rejection.lifetimeTooLong: A transfer may not last that long. Choose fewer days.
rejection.noRecipients: Choose at least one group, one person or one email address.
rejection.invalidEmail: An email address is not right. Please check it.
rejection.invalidRequest: That did not work. Please try again.

validation.lifetimeMin: A transfer lasts at least one whole day.
validation.aboveCeiling: This value is higher than the maximum for exceptions.
validation.openBelowTransfer: Open transfers must be at least as large as the largest transfer.
validation.defaultLifetime: The usual duration may not be longer than the longest duration.
validation.overrideDuplicate: This person already has an exception.

list.title: My transfers
list.empty: You haven't sent any transfers yet.

end.confirm: Do you want to end this transfer now? The files will be deleted and the links will stop working.

upload.title: Uploading files
upload.hint: Keep the app open until all files are uploaded.
upload.expired: The upload took too long. Please send the transfer again.
upload.failed: The upload didn't work. Check your connection and send the transfer again.
upload.aborted: You cancelled the upload. The transfer was not sent.

sent.done: The transfer is on its way to {count} recipients.

failure.generic: That didn't work. Please try again later.

request.done: Your request has reached the people in charge.

view.notFound: This transfer doesn't exist, or it isn't meant for you.

public.notFound: This link doesn't exist. Check that you copied all of it.
public.rateLimited: That was too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and then try again.
public.unavailable: The transfer can't be reached right now. Please try again later.
public.passwordText: This transfer is protected by a password. You got it from the person who sent it to you.
public.lockedText: You see the files and the message once you have entered the password.

contact.failed: The chat couldn't be opened. Please try again later.

blocked.title: Chat temporarily unavailable
blocked.default: The chat is currently under maintenance. It will be back soon.
